title: Tool Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Metabo LiHD tools light a solid LED1 indicator when the controller exceeds thermal limits. Tool inhibits run.

title: Battery Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Two flashing LEDs indicate the LiHD pack temperature is above operational range.

causes.cause: Hot pack from heavy current draw

title: Over-Current Trip
fullDescription: Three flashing LEDs indicate motor protection cut current due to stall or jam.

title: Battery Discharged
fullDescription: All LEDs off after a press of state-of-charge button means the pack is at protective cutoff.

title: Battery Communication Error
fullDescription: Alternating LED pattern indicates a communication failure between pack BMS and tool. Often due to dirty contacts.

fixSteps.title: Clean
fixSteps.instruction: Brush contacts on pack and tool.

title: Quick Stop Activated
fullDescription: Metabo Quick Stop disc brake on grinders triggered by sudden disc seizure or rotation.

fixSteps.title: Inspect disc
fixSteps.instruction: Check disc condition; release trigger to reset.

title: Charger Pack Fault
fullDescription: Steady red LED on ASC charger means the inserted pack failed self-test (cell imbalance, BMS lockout).

title: Charger Temperature Hold
fullDescription: Yellow blink while waiting for pack to cool or warm to 0-50 C charging window.

title: Brushless Hall Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Tool jolts but does not spin; commonly damaged Hall sensors or harness in EC-brushless motor.

title: Trigger Switch Fault
fullDescription: Five flashes of all SOC LEDs report a trigger module reading out of range, often dust contamination.

title: HPT cross-brand
fullDescription: HPT/Hitachi cross-brand fault. Common indication on Metabo cordless tools. Resolve by power-cycling, checking battery contacts, or contacting service.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean battery and tool contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test on another tool
fixSteps.instruction: Try battery in another compatible tool to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't fix or BMS continues to trip, warranty service may be needed.

faq.a: Maybe — try another known-good battery first.
Most cordless platforms have 3-year battery warranty.
